title: Chapter 91: Chapter 25: Return! Global Top Ten? Why So Weak?

Chapter 91: Chapter 25: Return! Global Top Ten? Why So Weak?

Chapter 91: Chapter 25: Return! Global Top Ten? Why So Weak?

“`

As if in a trance,

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“Is this death?”

Scenes from stepping into the space-time rift emerged in Lin Yuan’s mind.

It was an endless and chaotic flow of space.

Without color, without direction.

...

Before Lin Yuan could react, his body began to collapse.

The Taiji Field, his physical form, consciousness, soul, and everything else.

All collapsing.

“Lucky I didn’t go in twenty years ago, otherwise what a waste of time that would’ve been.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

From the first glimpse of the space-time rift, Lin Yuan felt an extreme sense of danger.

So he decided to leave decisively.

He spent those twenty years continuing to travel the world.

Seeking enlightenment along the way, and incidentally solving several disasters for the Greater Yan Dynasty,

training several Martial Gods and firmly establishing the Liu family’s reign.

“How exactly did that Ancient Godly Being from ten thousand years ago leave?”

Lin Yuan wondered slightly.

According to his speculation, the Ancient Godly Being could have been at most Fourth Rank peak,

definitely not surpassing Fifth Rank.

Yet, facing that level of spatial turbulence, even a Fifth Rank would not survive for long.

“Anyway.”

Lin Yuan decided not to overthink it.

He started to take stock of this traversal.

Without a doubt, the greatest gain from this traversal was

opening up the Third and Fourth Rank levels of the Martial Arts Evolution System.

Although before the traversal, Lin Yuan had already stepped into Third Rank,

he had just entered the beginning phase of Third Rank,

the middle phase, late phase, and peak, and so on,

were all perfected in the Divine Arms World.

In the end, he even took the big leap into Fourth Rank.

One must know… The path of cultivation that Lin Yuan chose was the most difficult, the path of the essence of rules.

If it were just a normal breakthrough to Fourth Rank, it certainly wouldn’t have taken Lin Yuan so long.

“The essence of rules….”

Lin Yuan walked out of the nutrition capsule, faintly sensing the vast and endless rules from all directions of the cosmic starry sky.

Compared to the Divine Arms World, the essence of the rules in the Main World were undoubtedly much more powerful.

Not just vast, but also more complete.

In the Main World, trying to forcibly extract its essence of rules like the Ancient Godly Being did, is almost impossible.

It’s not a matter of strength, anyone who dares to do so will surely be crushed by the Main World’s overwhelming power.

…

“It’s been over two days, not too bad.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the time and had a clear idea in his mind.

One hundred and sixty years in the Divine Arms World, in the Main World, barely fifty hours had passed.

“My current realm… is probably equivalent to Fourth Rank, ninth stage?”

Lin Yuan assessed himself; just over ten years after suppressing the Sun and Moon Spear, he stepped into Fourth Rank.

The following eight or nine years were spent arranging nodes on the Five Sacred Battlefields,

in order to form the Taiji Furnace to suppress the thirty-five Divine Weapons.

The twenty years of wandering the world after that,

were spent truly on enlightenment and cultivation.

From First Stage to Ninth Stage of Fourth Rank, basically all were perfected during these twenty years.

Of course, realm is realm,

Lin Yuan’s current strength still remained at the early stage of Third Rank.

“Choose the right Cosmic Spiritual Objects, and recovery will happen quickly.”

Lin Yuan opened the online marketplace and began to make his selections.

For an Evolver, the most important thing is their own realm.

What about power intensity? If you lose control over your realm, it’s meaningless.

“These two will do.”

After a moment of thought, Lin Yuan confirmed his choice of Spiritual Objects.

His cultivation system still revolved around Taiyin and Taiyang as the main core of the Taiji path,

so naturally, he chose Cosmic Spiritual Objects with Yin and Yang attributes.

“Twelve billion…”

Lin Yuan looked at the price.

This traversal had Lin Yuan advancing levels far beyond the past two times.

From the early stage of Third Rank to Fourth Rank, ninth stage, that’s a difference of twenty-one stages.

Therefore, the quality and level of the Cosmic Spiritual Objects he selected this time were naturally high.

Indeed,

had he not had Fourth Level Citizen privileges, Lin Yuan, no matter how wealthy,

would not even be able to see objects of such quality.

“Still short on money…”

Lin Yuan sighed.

Normally speaking, an Evolver at the early stage of Third Rank, cultivating to Fourth Rank, ninth stage, even with smooth sailing and no bottlenecks, would take hundreds or thousands of years.

This is provided that they have a complete Evolution Path to guide them.

For a Third Rank Evolver spreading the cost of twelve billion over hundreds of years, it’s not a pressure at all.

It’s just Lin Yuan, this peculiar freak, whose advancement speed in a short period was too fast, leading to his wealth not being able to keep up.

“Fourth Level citizens have a ten billion loan limit, plus my tournament winnings…”

Lin Yuan confirmed his identity information and purchased the two Cosmic Spiritual Objects.

The group stage of this tournament provided Lin Yuan with nearly ten billion in prize money.

As for the individual competition… since the individual competition has not yet ended, all prize money will be settled once it’s over.

“Let’s upload the ‘Third Rank Chapter’ that was deduced from this traversal.”

Facing a decrease in his account balance, Lin Yuan made up his mind.

Uploading the subsequent parts of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has only benefits for Lin Yuan, no disadvantages.

Firstly, it would result in a large amount of Merit Points.

In the Cosmic Human Alliance, Merit Points are extremely important.

Ordinary citizens primarily have three ways to earn Merit Points.

One is to enlist in the army and fight with Different Species on the frontier.

For every Different Species killed, you contribute to the whole Human Civilization, thus you can obtain corresponding Merit Points.

Another way is to serve the Human Civilization, and based on the assessment of the three goddesses, one can also receive relevant Merit Points.

Take the governor of Canglan Star for example,

if public satisfaction is high during his tenure,

and he makes genuine contributions to the planet, he can receive corresponding Merit Points as a reward.
